crossRefs.note: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’

translations.web: The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.
translations.bsb: “What troubles you?” the king asked her. “Indeed,” she said, “I am a widow, for my husband is dead.
translations.kjv: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.
translations.asv: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, Of a truth I am a widow, and my husband is dead.
